description:
Copy a product into another workspace (agency accounts). Non-destructive: the original is untouched and the copy lands as an unsynced DRAFT (no store mapping, fresh variants). Use list_my_workspaces to get the destination workspace uuid. If the product lives in a non-Default workspace, pass source_workspace too.

[#d046a8]

destination_workspace.description: Destination workspace uuid to copy/move into. Get it from list_my_workspaces (resolve a client/brand name to its uuid).

source_workspace.description: The workspace the asset currently lives in. Omit only if it is in your Default workspace; otherwise you must pass it (the platform scopes reads to a single workspace).

name: copy_product_to_workspace
